context: Declare the missing token in both theme blocks. Prefer reusing the tone-info treatment that already passes over minting new tokens; only introduce a theme-aware --bb-selected-* pair if a solid fill is explicitly chosen. Add a hygiene test so the undeclared-token class of defect cannot recur - it needs an allowlist because ~18 :root tokens are legitimately light-only (fonts, breakpoints, type scale, insets, skeleton metrics).
description: A systematic audit of every bg/text token pair in results-explorer/src, with contrast computed for both themes at HEAD 39ead3a41, found three defects. (1) --bb-tone-warning-border is referenced on five zero-state banners - BenchmarkIndex.tsx:701, PlatformIndex.tsx:682, Compare.tsx:1019, Query.tsx:888, ComparabilityReceipt.tsx:49 - and is declared nowhere in index.css. It is the only referenced-but-undeclared --bb-* token in the app; border-color silently falls back to currentColor, so those banners outline themselves in the warning text colour and read far heavier than every other panel. (2) accent-hover on fg-primary computes to 2.66:1 light and 4.26:1 dark, failing AA in both themes, at Home.tsx:1165 (tuning/trust/date filter chips) and Query.tsx:721 (row-limit chips). Critically --bb-fg-inverse is NOT a valid blanket fix: in dark it is #0d1117 giving 4.08:1, worse than today. Meanwhile BenchmarkIndex.tsx:601 already paints its active trust chips with tone-info-bg on tone-info-fg, which computes to 8.49:1 light and 9.74:1 dark - so the app already contains a passing treatment for the same control. (3) surface-app on data-fg-subtle computes to 4.40:1 light at BenchmarkIndex.tsx:605, a marginal AA miss on inactive trust chips. .btn-danger also computes 3.70:1 light and 3.08:1 dark but is referenced only by a primitives test, so it is latent rather than shipping. Sixteen pairs were checked; the remaining ones clear 4.5:1 in both themes. Not compare-path work - both adversarial reviews were explicit that this must not ride in the compare batch.

anti_patterns.dont: Assert every :root token also exists in the dark block without an allowlist
anti_patterns.why: ~18 tokens including fonts, breakpoints, type scale, insets and skeleton radii are correctly theme-invariant

anti_patterns.dont: Bundle this into the compare-path batch
anti_patterns.why: these chips are Home filter and Query row-limit controls with no compare involvement, and both reviews called the coupling out

anti_patterns.instead: INSTEAD reuse tone-info, or mint a theme-aware pair if solid is chosen
anti_patterns.why: fg-inverse flips per theme and lands at 4.08 to 1 on accent-hover in dark, worse than the 4.26 it replaces

preserves.behavior: Both themes stay above 4.5 to 1 for normal text after the change
Existing passing pairs keep their current values - only the three failing pairs change
The ~18 legitimately light-only tokens stay light-only via an explicit allowlist, not by weakening the test

prior_art.concept: active trust chips already use the passing tone-info pair

verifications.command: cd results-explorer/src && grep -rno 'var(--bb-[a-z0-9-]*)' . | sed 's/.*var(//;s/)//' | sort -u > /tmp/u && grep -o -- '--bb-[a-z0-9-]*:' index.css | sed 's/:$//' | sort -u > /tmp/d && comm -23 /tmp/u /tmp/d
cd results-explorer && npx vitest run src/__tests__/themeTokenHygiene.test.ts
verifications.description: Hygiene test catches a deliberately undeclared token
verifications.expected: pass, and fails when a bogus var is introduced
